live_evidence.current_renderer: Native action view or client tag, NOT batch5-bound scaffold

unbound_policy: Leave 8 native menu surfaces in place. Do not route Mesh release, Elements, Clusters, Verbs, Map, Lenses, Architecture register or Lexicon through a generic N.MESH screen or a restricted source.
implementation_contract: Use action_xmlid plus menu_id as exact anchors; preserve each native action model, view modes, domain, current record operations, and direct navigation.
Bind 43 already declared landing screens by their exact immutable screen_id; never derive ID from changing UI labels.
Do not invent declarations for 8 unmatched native/special surfaces; return them as SOURCE_OR_SPECIAL_SURFACE_GAPS for Support/Integration, with their existing UI retained.

The two record declarations SCR.CONTEXT.RECORD and SCR.ASSET.RECORD are conditional on actual permitted record instances; not general menu defaults. SCR.MESH.NOUN is a general concept, not a substitute for specialised Mesh catalogues.

Keep existing groups: root 34, leaf 35 for the two Steward-only references. Group membership, source permission and model record rules must be enforced server-side, never assumed from visible menu metadata.
Do not show source content or even a hidden response payload for a Context unentitled actor. Missing source is marked UNSOURCED/HOLD; not silently filled from registry or historical V19 data.
Retain nine action groups under existing top-level Form/Flow/Evolve, separate from Architecture; never equate nine action groups and nine Strategy overlays.
No protected install or source adoption under this N1 spec; separate D007 release, D009 and Steward user tests for browser behaviour, client/Collaborator and 390/1024px.
one_next: Code (one existing builder) consumes this N1 JSON and builds a source-only batch5 overlay for 43 mapped menus, leaving 8 existing native views; return one patch/tree hash, 43 binding asserts, 8 untouched asserts and fail-closed role/source negatives. No Odoo deployment from this packet.
